Guidance & outlook: Our solutions enhance brand visibility on packaging, reduce the risk of counterfeiting, and improve the operational performance.
Sir, when I see our volumes in FY24, I think they were close to around 30,000 tons and FY 26 was around 38,000 tons.
We expect to maintain these good results going forward and start our new plant quickly.
Growth & demand: Our consolidated revenue for quarter one financial year '27 stood at INR2,647.71 million compared to INR1,871.71 million in quarter one financial year '26, registering an year-on-year growth of 40.50%.

We witnessed broad - based demand across -- in the market including foods, grains, pulses, pet food, fertilizers, agrochemicals, and consumer end m arket supporting volume growth across our product portfolio.

Our total sales volume for quarter 1 financial year '27 stood at 10,940 metric tons compared to 9,047 metric tons in quarter 1 financial year '26, representing a year-on-year growth of approximately 20.90%.
Margins & costs: Moving to EBITDA, our consolidated EBITDA for quarter 1 financial year '27 stood INR591.73 million compared to INR386.41 million in quarter 1 financial year '26, representing a year-on- year growth of 53.14%.
Our EBITDA margin improved to 22.35% versus 20.65% in quarter 1 financial year '26.

Capex & expansion: We are currently operating at more than 48,000 metric ton per annum capacity with our including rented facilities and translating into an approximately 91% capacity utilization.
Once new plant funded by IPO proceeds is commissioned, which remains on track for October 2027, our total installed capacity will reach approximately 70,000 metric ton per annum.
So, always capacity -- today, we are almost using 90% to 91%, 92% capacity.
Balance sheet & cash: We continue to invest in new product development and leverage our first mover advantage across multiple product categories.
Until the new plant become operational, we will leverage rented facility for semi -finished goods production while the value -added processing will remain at our existing manufacturing facility.
The improvement in the EBITDA and margin was primarily due to operating leverage and a strong cost management discipline.
Risks & challenges: In a volatile mac roeconomic environment, a resilient supply chain is a key competitive advantage.

We remain focused on ramping up our commissioned capacity, improving utilization, maintaining cost discipli ne, and strengthening customer relationship, while continue to efficiently manage raw material price volatility.
